title: Write the adopted LocoHub sagittal sign rule into the reference
summary: Added one authoritative 'Signs and frames' section (Markdown source and authored HTML) stating decisions D-UM21-C03-1 = C and D-GT21-C01-1 = B: frame (+x walking, +y up, +z person's right), counterclockwise positive for all sagittal signals (gait2392), internal moments with the angle's sign, power = moment x joint speed, sideways GRF/COP outward per leg. Compact table covers 16 signal families with positive direction, one-line physical definition and gait2392 equivalent; frontal/transverse signs are stated as not yet adopted. Added a labeled sagittal SVG diagram and a callout that knee_flexion_angle, knee_flexion_moment and pelvis_sagittal_angle are negative in their named direction. DATA_CONTRACT.md gained a short summary pointing to the section. Contradicting active statements were fixed or marked historical. Docs only; no converter, data, backlog or AGENTS edits.
